pages.text: Your soul weapons can learn new abilities beyond their defaults.$(br2)Place a completed soul weapon in a $(thing)crafting table$() along with specific materials to begin a $(thing)skill forging task$().$(br2)Each weapon can only have one active task at a time. Fulfill the requirements while wielding the weapon, and the new skill will be permanently unlocked.

Check the weapon's tooltip for your current task and progress. Be warned: Some tasks have time limits, taking too long will cause the progress to reset. $(br2)When a weapon has more than one skill, press the $(thing)Switch Skill() key ($(thing)R$() by default) to switch skill.
